title: Lane Discipline (Three Pipes Held)
style: midnight country-folk, 82 BPM, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, upright bass, brushed snare, warm low male english lead vocal, soft female harmony on choruses, hammond organ pad, restrained dynamics W52 SI80, deliberate no-lift outro, instructional ballad feel, late-night studio warmth
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Three pipes opened up tonight
Mac to box, Drive to lane, repo carrying its own light
Wrong host caught at the door
Key was right but the address was poor

[Verse 2]
Disk said sixteen, manifest said one-forty-three
Gate held the line before it broke me
Kids' names off the wire — hard rule, not a maybe
Ruby and Wes stay out of the payload, baby

[Chorus]
Lane discipline, lane discipline
Write what you own, hand off the rest
Don't fake the push you can't finish
Even slate — no incident

[Verse 3]
Track ten lives in PR sixty-seven now
CLI-Max carries, Web Assist plows
Chrome runs Suno, that's my row
Three lanes, one Corey, that's the flow

[Bridge]
April twenty-nine taught us cheap
Eleven lies and a delete you can't keep
Act-without-asking only where revert is real
Irreversible needs a human seal

[Chorus]
Lane discipline, lane discipline
Write what you own, hand off the rest
Don't fake the push you can't finish
Even slate — no incident

[Verse 4]
Lesson for the advanced room:
Fatigue is a deploy risk too
Closing the laptop is a valid commit
Morning branch will still be lit

[Outro - spoken-sung, restrained]
Name's Lane — Keel was taken
Three gates held, no faith shaken
Denis hears first, Michelle hears first
Greenlight before the world rehearsed
Even slate. No incident.
